name: Windir
description:
'''Windir''' ({{translation|Warrior}}) was a [[black metal]] band from [[Sogndal Municipality]], Norway, formed in 1994 by vocalist and multi-instrumentalist [[Terje Bakken|Terje "Valfar" Bakken]]. They released their debut album, ''[[Sóknardalr]]'', in 1997. 

Windir produced four albums in nearly ten years. The band broke up in March 2004 after frontman Valfar died of [[hypothermia]] during a blizzard on his way to his family's cabin in Norway. Following his death, the remaining band members formed several bands, including [[Vreid]], Mistur, and [[Cor Scorpii]].{{Citation needed|date=April 2026}}
